 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Exestentialism'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling is 'Existentialism'.**
 
• The word '**Existentialism**' is a **philosophical theory** or approach that emphasizes the existence of the individual as a free and responsible agent determining their own development through acts of the will.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**, i.e., 'Exestentialism'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words:**

 
• **Dialectic:** A method of argument for resolving disagreement that has been central to European and Indian philosophy since antiquity.
 
• **Solipsism:** The view or theory that the self is all that can be known to exist.
 
• **Determinism:** The doctrine that all events, including human action, are ultimately determined by causes regarded as external to the will.
